method: A source-only extraction containing IDs, situations and complete messages/scripts was used to assess practical intention and progression. Full item JSON was then inspected, including every question, option, explanation, brief and alt.
No prior pass, numeric rating, author note, balanced-key count or source word count was treated as evidence of semantic quality.
A familiar playful visual oddity is permitted. Findings concern the surrounding human exchange, not the presence of humour.
Literal evidence containment and key entailment were checked separately from source coherence. Every option has an item-specific assessment.
No source, prior review, catalogue or global file was edited; no repair wording or replacement exercise was invented.

rating_scale.5: A clear practical purpose and natural progression, without semantic repairs needed.
rating_scale.4: A coherent core with a specific minor-to-moderate unmotivated addition.
rating_scale.3: The purpose is recognisable, but inventories or unconnected facts materially weaken the message.
rating_scale.2: Several replies or facts require an invented purpose or missing causal link.
rating_scale.1: The central exchange lacks a coherent practical meaning.

verdict_policy: Revise means a recognisable practical core remains. Reject means the current source/question design should be replaced rather than accepted after a cosmetic wording edit. Verdicts apply to the audited bytes only.

summary.main_result: All 18 need source-level editorial work. All 36 keys have literal source support; that mechanical success did not prevent semantic failures.
recurring_failures: Unrequested pairs/triples of objects, people, locations or quantities become distractor stock. Their presence in the source is mistaken for communicative relevance.
Listening speakers recite candidate answers or offer a forced binary guess before another speaker supplies the third option.
Replies change the subject or answer a different question; the listener must invent the unstated goal, reason or missing action.
Some questions compare overlapping spatial categories or treat an unstated possession as explicitly false.
The same structure recurs beneath varied visual jokes: an oddity announcement, two sets of contrast facts, then two literal matching questions.
summary.playfulness: The plant eyes, hat ears, duck, fish cake, working cat, suitcase seat, party-hat dog, banana phone, chair eyes, broom dance, box ears, open umbrella and cup flower are not rejection reasons in themselves.
